verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins can be driven programmatically through documented CLI commands such as `codex plugin marketplace add` [docs-11] and through a documented plugin.json manifest schema [docs-30]. Its public marketplace catalog was fetched keylessly as JSON [probe-rt-1], and third-party tooling installed a catalog skill outside Codex [probe-rt-2]. However, there is no documented public REST API for managing plugins: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path [probe-3], and publishing goes through a portal and Plugins page [docs-31, docs-56]. Missing for 10: a documented public HTTP API for installing, managing and submitting plugins, an OpenAPI spec, and an API-based publication workflow.
